Well, folks, once again we see the deep state and progressive activist apparatus bending over backwards to undermine our borders and handcuff the very people tasked with upholding our laws. We are looking at a system where federal ICE lawyers had to deal with an agency memo from May of last year that supposedly gave no authorization for the arrests, yet thousands of individuals who shouldn't even be here in the first place were being processed. 

Now the left-wing lawyers and open-borders activists are running to court, whining about due process and demanding radical institutional reform of the very agencies trying to protect our nation's sovereignty. They want you to believe this is some sort of predatory deceit, but let’s be honest about what’s really going on: our immigration enforcement officers are just trying to do their jobs and maintain basic law and order, while activist judges and entrenched bureaucrats tie their hands. If we don't have borders and we don't enforce the law, we don't have a country. It’s time to stop apologizing for law enforcement and start putting the safety of American citizens first.
